notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
description:
Activate Krav by paying {B} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to draw a card, gain 1 life, and put a +1/+1 counter on Krav.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Carnival of Souls, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Repeat.
